enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap and shampoo. Rinse body and hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, and butter. Close refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Place frying pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan and stir. Turn off stove. Take toast from toaster. Put eggs and toast on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass and walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass and place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital and walk to locker room. Change into scrubs and walk to nurse station. Check schedule. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to next patient room. Repeat patient rounds. Attend team meeting. Use computer to update records. Take phone call. Discuss with colleague. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Walk back to nurse station. Continue patient rounds. Finish shift. Change out of scrubs and walk out of hospital.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter apartment.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash and chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Place frying pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken and stir. Add vegetables and stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Rinse plate and place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote and turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up and walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator, take out water, close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water. Put down glass. Pick up remote and turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.
Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

Enter living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open web browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Watch video. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue using computer. Open game. Play game. Close game. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.
